purpose: Photoreal presentation enhancements of native model camera views
invariants: Architecture and layout preserved; soft material and planting detail illustrative

prompts.front: Use case: sketch-to-render. Edit target: the attached exact native model render of Ashley Heights. Produce a breathtakingly photorealistic architectural photograph for a luxury house brochure, landscape 3:2 highest resolution. Preserve EXACT camera, silhouette, all gables and roof intersections, every window and glazing mullion, all wall shapes, entrance doors and garage, gate and boundary walls, car location. NO redesign, no new openings, no changed roof forms. Replace ONLY the primitive faceted green tree shapes with realistic leafy mature trees/evergreen planting in precisely the same locations and general envelopes. Preserve white mineral rendered house walls, pale oak garage and entrance doors, subtle grey tile roof, dark bronze frames, red brick boundary. Correct the severely overexposed image to natural late-afternoon architectural photography: controlled white highlights, rich subtle grey roof tiles, soft contact shadows, physically credible reflections, excellent texture in oak and render. Visible roofing should remain tiled. Every fine detail razor sharp, realistic botanical foliage, natural sky, editorial architecture photography with straight verticals. Keep composition unchanged, no text or people. This is an enhancement of this exact house, not a new house.
prompts.kitchen: Use case: sketch-to-render. Input is edit target, the exact modelled kitchen and garden dining room at Ashley Heights. Make this into an exceptionally photorealistic luxury interior architecture photograph, 3:2 landscape high resolution. Preserve EXACT architecture, camera, open-plan room dimensions, beam and opening shapes, glazing panels and handles, ALL furniture footprints, kitchen island/cabinets, two stacked black ovens and their small controls, pendant locations, dining table and every chair, sofa position. No redesign, no extra furniture. Preserve warm pale natural oak, ivory upholstery, creamy limestone, bronze fittings. Improve ONLY realistic materials, microtexture, refined joins, glass reflection/transmission and natural soft daylight. Replace simplified trees visible outside with lush realistic planting in same positions, lawn with natural fine grass. The photograph should feel tactile, calm and premium: subtle linen and oak grain, limestone pores, convincing contact shadows, soft lighting with controlled highlights, no plastic surfaces, no excessive yellow or orange grading. Keep plants and table styling where shown; softly natural realistic foliage and pears. Straight verticals, crisp fine detail. No text, no people. Stay faithful to this specific model.

Refine the rigid blocky pillows and duvet into real premium linen bedding with subtle natural folds and upholstered softness, but keep their size, number, position, bed outline and height essentially unchanged. Improve realistic cloth weave, fine oak grain, stitching, stone texture, daylight, subtle contact shadows and ceiling light strip. Window must stay same shape, location and divisions; give it soft daylight and believable garden reflection. Calm bright architectural editorial photography, natural white balance, no oversaturation, no redesign, no added furniture or art, no people, no text. Must remain recognisably the same modelled room.

Create an exceptionally photorealistic luxury architectural photograph, landscape 3:2 high resolution. Keep exact camera, room geometry, ALL three visible windows with same heights and sizes and frosted privacy glass, shower glass edge and drain on left, bath footprint and sculptural rounded shape, pedestal table position, floorstanding bath filler on right with handshower, oak bath tray and folded towel. Tactile realistic stone, no excessive yellow cast, no added marble veining, no text, no people. Geometry and arrangement must remain precisely recognisable.

prompts.pool_tile: Precise single-material correction to this photo. Keep the ENTIRE image unchanged, including the architecture, camera, windows, roof outlines, pool, water, trees, light, balcony and all other details. ONLY the dark grey vertical cladding on the dormer visible at the top right must change from long vertical standing-seam-like strips to traditional small rectangular grey hanging roof tiles in closely spaced horizontal overlapping courses, subtly staggered joints. The front face around the dormer window AND its narrow left cheek must both show grey hanging tiles matching the main roof palette. Keep the window absolutely identical and retain every dormer edge and size. Absolutely no white render on this dormer. Photorealistic slate-grey tile texture with fine realistic joints. No other changes. Output same crop and aspect ratio, highest resolution.
